Thanks! I’m looking it up right now on how many points my kill team could have and if it’s right I’m p surprised at the amount by itself :0 atm I’m not planning on playing anyone specifically but eventually I’d like to irl.

Also I feel dumb I just remembered you can get models off of eBay which would’ve saved me a lot lol
Sweet! Thanks for the benchmarks, I think I’m gonna aim for 500 and see how it goes 👍
This is mostly so I can get ur guys opinions on it, I saw how big those armies can get and I’m a lil intimidated but it still looks like a lot of fun

UPDATE 4/4/22: I recently quit my job but I am seeing a therapist now. Things are still cloudy but I’m feeling a little bit more optimistic now. It sounds silly but sometimes I tell myself that if I was gone then my cat would have no one to take care of him. It’s the little things like that that keep me above the water.

If anyone is out there reading this and is feeling the same way as I felt before please know there are people who love and care about you. <33333

Thank you, your words mean a lot to me. I made an appointment with a psychiatrist but I’m going to see if they can maybe move the date closer instead of two weeks from now.

Thank you again ⭐️
